Handout 2: tHe last Will and testaMent oF JoseF Flook
2512
Being the last will and testament of Josef Flook of Kupfertal upon the fourteenth day of Pflugzeit in the year of Sigmar two thousand and five hundred and twelve. Know that all my worldly goods shall be passed down to my daughter and heir who is Anthea Flook of Kupfertal. This I declare in the name of Verena, may she see this justly observed, and of Sigmar may his peace protect it, and of Morr may he have mercy upon us all. Josef Flook
